_about: Tests about the playtest town itself, not about a system that needs a fixture. No suite run carries them (tools\cli test --tier all|persistence, ci, wt gate, wt ship); `tools\cli test --no-build --town` runs the whole list in one boot of the playtest world (DebugWorld, mission 3). The main guard runs it as a separate, warn-only stage after the suite (a `main-guard/town` status, never a revert) and the lead runs it before `promote` (docs/worktrees.md "Main guard", docs/architecture/three-worlds.md). The tests stay registered; only where they run changes.
